issues.body: CARGO_INSTALL_ALLOWLIST remains keyed only by filename. test_no_source_compile_outside_allowlist subtracts release.yml regardless of its hit count or job location, while test_allowlist_is_not_stale only checks that at least one hit exists. Therefore, adding another `cargo install wasm-pack` in any release.yml job, or duplicating it within gui-bundle, remains undetected despite the comments claiming exactly one allowlisted site. This is materially the same regression-gate hole reported in round 1.
issues.fix_hint: Represent the exemption at site granularity, such as workflow plus job id or an exact step identity, and assert exactly one matching source-install step in release.yml under gui-bundle. Add a mutation test containing the legitimate gui-bundle step plus a second source-install step elsewhere in release.yml and assert that the guard fails.
issues.title: The release exemption still allowlists the entire workflow

verdict.summary: Round 2 does not resolve the prior major finding. The workflow conversions appear consistent, but the regression guard still exempts release.yml as a whole rather than the single gui-bundle install site it claims to allow. A second source-compiled wasm-pack step anywhere in release.yml would still pass both allowlist tests. The exemption needs site identity and exact cardinality enforcement.
